messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a small pilot: 'Fallback Credits' (FBC). Idea: per-route credits that, when consumed, cause traffic to route to an inexpensive fallback model or reduced feature set instead of failing. Goal: give customers control over graceful degradation + predictable cost. Thoughts?

Alex (Eng): Nice. Two main modes: fallback-model (route -> smaller model) or feature-flag (disable heavy steps). Implementation: credit-check in router, tag request, switch pool. Need metrics + throttles.

Kim (DevEx): UX: attach FBC to a route, choose fallback behavior, set thresholds (e.g., apply after X errors or when latency > Y). Show live burn-rate and hist. Minimal pilot UI is fine.

Ravi (Sales): Customers love deterministic downgrade options. Call it "route-level budgeted fallbacks" in sales decks. Pricing idea: monthly bundles + on-demand top-ups. Pilot offer: free 500 credits for 90 days to pilot accounts.

Nora (Finance): Quick margin calc: if fallback model is 1/4 cost, credits translate to explicit reserved capacity cost. Need SKU-level margin assumptions. Also think about revenue deferral if bundled credits included in enterprise contracts.

Priya (Legal): We must avoid promising behavior under all conditions. Recommend language: "Fallback behavior is best-effort; availability of fallback capacity not guaranteed unless reserved." Also require customers to opt-in for routing to customer-hosted fallbacks.

Maya (PM): Proposed pilot scope: 2 routes per customer, one fallback-model option + feature-flag option. Pilot deliverables: tech-spec, pilot T&Cs, two customers identified, PRD w/ success metrics. Launch criteria: <10% increase in platform cost at 95th percentile, clear customer satisfaction signal, no security gaps.

Alex (Eng): Rough effort: spec + infra hooks ~1 sprint, routing + metrics + tests ~2 sprints. If we reuse existing model-pool abstractions, faster. Need a canary plan for routing changes.

Kim (DevEx): Console fields: 
- select fallback type (model|feature)
- credit budget (units)
- auto-topup (on/off)
- event feed for fallback triggers
I can mock screens this week.

Ravi (Sales): Pilot pitch points: reduces user-facing errors, gives predictable bill, ops-safe. Target pilot candidates: two SMBs with bursty workloads + one mid-market with strict availability SLAs.

Nora (Finance): SKU thought: FBC-STD (1000 credits/mo) $199, FBC-BOOST (5000 credits/mo) $799, pay-as-you-go $0.25/credit. Need to vet numbers with compute team.

Maya (PM): Draft SKU snippet for discussion:

```
sku_id: FBC-STD-1000
name: "Fallback Credits — Standard"
units: credits
bundle: 1000
price_usd: 199
validity_days: 30
behavior: "route -> fallback-model OR disable-heavy-features"
```

Priya (Legal): Also add audit logging requirement and explicit customer consent for traffic steering. For pilot, include a rollback clause.

Alex (Eng): Ops ask: simulate 10x burst and measure credit burn + fallback pool pressure. @ops-bot can you enqueue a scenario that models a 2-minute spike with 50% requests eligible for fallback?

ops-bot: Enqueued sim job #7629: "FBC pilot 2-min 10x spike". ETA 2h. Results will be posted here.

Maya (PM): Next steps: Alex + Kim -> tech spec & console mock; Priya -> draft pilot T&Cs; Ravi -> shortlist pilot accounts; Nora -> finalize preliminary pricing impact. I'll compile PRD draft Friday EOD. Thanks everyone :)
